camel_example: aliyun alidns ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleZoneName 'example.com' --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000' --EnableStatus enable --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000' --ScheduleDomainName 'www.example.com' --Remark test
description_en: Retrieves a list of instance configurations that contain access domain names and address pool information
description_zh: 获取实例配置列表，包括接入域名、地址池信息等
kebab_example: aliyun alidns list-cloud-gtm-instance-configs --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000 --schedule-zone-name example.com --enable-status enable --remark test --schedule-domain-name www.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The root domain, such as example.com, or subdomain, such as a.example.com, of the GTM access domain name. This is typically a domain name that is hosted in an authoritative zone in the Alibaba Cloud DNS console and belongs to the same account as the GTM instance
parameters.help_zh: GTM接入域名的主域（example.com）或子域（a.example.com）。一般为GTM实例所在账号下，在云解析DNS控制台权威解析中托管的域名
parameters.name: schedule_zone_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the domain name instance:

enable: The GTM instance uses intelligent scheduling policies.

disable: The intelligent scheduling policies of the GTM instance are unavailable
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例的启用状态：

enable：启用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略生效。

disable：禁用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略不可用
parameters.name: enable_status

parameters.help_en: The GTM access domain name. The domain name is a combination of the host record (ScheduleHostname) and the root or subdomain (ScheduleZoneName)
parameters.help_zh: GTM接入域名。格式为接入域名主机记录（ScheduleHostname参数值）+主域或子域（ScheduleZoneName参数值）
parameters.name: schedule_domain_name
